utarbeide arsregnskapet: Ja
Grunnlag for avgivelse
Ar 2025: Arsregnskap er elektronisk innlevert.
Ar 2024: Tall er hentet fra elektronisk innlevert Aarsregnskap fra 2025.
Virksomheten sitt overste organ er ansvarlig for at arsregnskapet er signert.
Det er mulig a levere arsregnskap uten signatur fordi sikkerheten for rett
rapportering er ivaretatt ved at innsenderen har rolle/rettighet for innsending
i Altinn. Navnet pa representanten, som bekrefter at arsregnskapet er godkjent,
er i tillegg oppgitt.

Accounting principles

The annual accounts have been prepared in conformity with the Accounting Act and
NRS 8 - Good accounting practice for small companies.

Operating revenues

Income from the sale of goods is recognised on the date of delivery. Services are posted
to income as they are delivered.

Tax

The tax charge in the profit and loss account consists of tax payable for the period and
the change in deferred tax. Deferred tax is calculated at the tax rate at 22 % on the basis
of tax-reducing and tax-increasing temporary differences that exist between accounting
and tax values, and the tax loss carried forward at the end of the accounting year. Tax-
increasing and tax-reducing temporary differences that reverse or may reverse in the
same period are set off and entered net.

Classification and valuation of current assets

Current assets and short-term liabilities normally include items that fall due for payment
within one year of the balance sheet date, as well as items that relate to the stock cycle.
Current assets are valued at the lower of acquisition cost and fair value.

Receivables

Receivables from customers and other receivables are entered at par value after
deducting a provision for expected losses. The provision for losses is made on the basis of
an individual assessment of the respective receivables.

Note 1 Nature of the business and location

Norus Renewables ASis a company whose activities comprise To develop, plan, design,
construct, operate, maintain, finance, and sell projects involving (i} solar power
installations, {ii} various energy storage solutions, {iii} solar-powered pumping and water
purification systems, {iv} solar-powered pumping and irrigation systems, and (v} other
renewable energy-based projects. The company's activities may also include investments
in other companies, as well as any other activities related to or supporting the
aforementioned business operations. The company is located in the municipality of Oslo,
Norway.

Note 2 Salary costs and benefits

Norus Renewables AS hasn't had any salary costs or benefits in 2025 and there are no
such obligations.

Note 7 Going concern

The result for 20245 shows a deficit of NOK - 1 174 736 against surplus NOK 990 647 in 2024.
The company incurred a loss in 2025, and there is uncertainty related to future revenues
and profitability. However, the board has evaluated the company's liquidity position, cost
structure and planned operational measures. During 2025, the shareholders strengthened
the company's financial position through a debt-to-equity conversion, resulting in an
increase in both share capital and share premium.

This transaction improved the company's equity position and reduced its debt obligations.
In addition, board has assessed the company's liquidity position, cost structure, and
expected future activity. Based on these assessments, together with planned measures to
improve profitability and secure future revenues, the board expects the company to be
able to meet its obligations in 2026. Accordingly, the board considers the the conditions
for going concern are satisfied, and the financial statements have been prepared on tis
basis.
